UpdateSourceArgs: -c "mkdir -p PEMK && if [ ! -d PEMK/project/.git ]; then git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SamDreamsMaker/pokemon-essentials-mmo-kit.git PEMK/project; else echo PEMK source already exists; fi"

-c "if [ ! -f PEMK/project/server/.env ]; then echo POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -hex 24) > PEMK/project/server/.env && chmod 600 PEMK/project/server/.env; else echo Keeping existing database password; fi"
